description: Count valid California driver licenses and identification cards held by residents of each county, as an annual series from 2008 onward. Answers "how many licensed drivers are in Los Angeles County", "which California county has the most driver licenses", or how a county's licensed-driver count has changed over time. Counts people holding a license or ID card, which is a different question from how many vehicles are registered — for that use ca_dmv_vehicle_registrations.

county.description: County name, matched as a substring, e.g. "Los Angeles", "Alameda".

year.description: Four-digit year between 2008 and 2024, e.g. "2024". Defaults to the most recent published.

name: ca_dmv_driver_licenses
title: Ca Dmv Driver Licenses
